protocol.bars: btckrw_1m causally aggregated to 30m; out-of-session buckets used only for the overnight and gap anchors
protocol.clock: New York wall-clock encoded as fake UTC; nothing converts
protocol.entry_spread_note: 0.2 USD on Exness BTCUSD expressed relatively; see the cost sweep in `validate`
protocol.fx: P&L, notional and risk are US dollars; non-USD quotes cross via a daily-median rate implied by btc_1m
protocol.selection_gate: >=5 of 6 in-sample years profitable; selected DD 3.0-15.0%; annual DD <=15.0%; >=200 trades; PF >=1.05; regime filters must refine an already profitable unfiltered cell; >=60% of numeric neighbours robust; >=80.0% of signals fillable on $1,000 in sample
protocol.session: 09:30-16:00 New York; entries inside it only, forced flatten at the close
protocol.sizing: riskvol_1.5pct against a per-symbol volatility target of 0.458 (in-sample median realised volatility), floored to the 0.01 base-unit step inside 0.0050 margin (Exness 1:200)
